we present a switched-capacitors voltage regulator that converts the battery voltage to the SoC's voltage with 70% efficiency.
a switched-capacitors (SC) DC/DC voltage regulator is presented that converts a 1.2V battery down to ~0V in order to supply the `brain' chip of a flapping wing microrobotic insect.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a low-power, high efficiency switched-capacitor converter for battery-powered micro-robots.
the design of a switched-capacitors (SC) DC/DC voltage regulator for powering the `brain' of a flapping wing microrobot.
the design of low-power and efficient voltage regulators for the next generation of autonomous microrobotic systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work presents a fully integrated battery-connected SC 4:1 DC-DC voltage converter with a charge recycling technique that achieves 70% peak and 60% average conversion efficiency and 1% droop.
this work demonstrates a fully integrated switched-capacitor voltage regulator for a battery-powered micro-robotic system.
this work presents a switched capacitor DC-DC voltage converter that is able to convert 3.7 volts down to ~0.V in order to power an SoC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a 4: 1 SC DC-DC converter with 70% efficiency and 10% output droop for a 47mA load current.
we have developed a 4:2 SC voltage regulator that can be cascaded to achieve a 4:8 conversion ratio with high efficiency and low output voltage droop.
we have developed a fully integrated switched-capacitor DC-DC voltage converter that converts 3.7 to 0.8V with 70% efficiency, 0.1% output ripple, 10% output droop, and 1MHz switching frequency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bottom-plate loss is a major bottleneck in SC DC-DC conversion, but it can be mitigated using a charge recycling scheme.
the bottom-plate parasitics in flying capacitors can be reduced by charge recycling and that SC converters are well suited for low voltage applications.
the SC converter is a viable option for low-voltage battery applications.
